notes: Only the first (main) model of the 3-in-1 booklet, the Mini Digger, is recorded. The two alternative builds reuse the same 57 pieces, so listing them would double-count. This model uses every piece in the parts list exactly once, and the type counts match the list.

The booklet images are small and low resolution. The piece-to-piece assignments are my best reading, not certain. The least certain are: which pieces carry the orange plates and the yellow bracket at the rear, where the second yellow 2x3 plate, the DBG round plates and the 1x2 bar-up plate sit on the front assembly, and the exact stacking of the bucket.
Pieces b2 and b17 (wheel-holder plates) hang under the plates they clutch (b1 and b16). I recorded them as resting on those plates, i.e. as clutched against them.
The front sub-assembly (page 4) is b16-b21. It joins the rear by the half pin b22 through the hole of b21 and into the open stud of the round brick b8, so it can swivel.

The red round plates b14 and b15 push onto the mudguard's molded headlight studs. The trans-yellow tiles b31 and b32 clip onto the clips of two 1x1 clip plates. The black bars b48 and b49 are the digger arms. They clip onto the bar of b33 and onto the side handles of the bucket.
The bucket (page 7-8) is two side-handle plates end to end, then a 1x4 plate, a 2x4 plate and a 1x2 panel between two corner panels. The three wheel holders' wheels and tyres are added last (page 9).
